For vendors

More jobs. Less chasing. Get paid on time.

Anna.I fills your calendar with matched, vetted jobs — and pays out reliably through verified milestone completion. No more chasing leads, no-show clients, or payment disputes.

Steady job flow

Anna.I batches and routes jobs to fill your schedule efficiently, instead of you chasing leads across multiple apps. Jobs come to you — matched to your category, capacity, and availability.

Fair, on-time payouts

Milestone escrow means payment is held before the job starts and released the moment your work is verified complete. No chasing customers, no disputes, no bad debt.

Build a reputation that compounds

Longitudinal performance scoring — not one-off star ratings — means good work keeps earning you more bookings at better rates over time.

Simple tools, not another complicated app

Job dispatch, scheduling, and payout tracking in one place — built for how vendors actually work, not a bloated platform you have to learn.

How it works

From application to payout — four steps.

No complicated onboarding. No multi-step wizards. Apply once, get vetted, and start receiving matched jobs.

01

Apply and get vetted

Background check, identity verification, and skills validation. One application — not a listing you have to maintain.

02

Receive matched job dispatches

Anna.I routes jobs based on your category, capacity, and schedule. You see the job, the pay, and the household details before accepting.

03

Complete the job, upload photo verification

Do the work. Upload photo proof of completion. The household approves — no back-and-forth arguments about whether something was done.

04

Get paid — automatically, on verified completion

Payment releases from escrow the moment the job is confirmed done. No invoicing, no chasing, no waiting 30 days for a transfer.
